newsitem.title: UK: Ladbroke advances as court rebuffs Camelot.
newsitem.headline: Ladbroke advances as court rebuffs Camelot.

text.p: Shares in Ladbroke Group Plc rose 5-1/2p to 255-1/2p on Monday after a UK court dismissed lottery-operator Camelot's attempt to have a numbers bet made illegal.
Ladbroke was unchanged before the news.
Magistrate Ronald Bartle said he accepted the defence argument that the game was a bet and "not a lottery".
"This decision was expected but it is still a relief. It's helped the shares," said one leisure analyst.
The bet - 49's - is run by Ladbroke, bookmakers Coral and William Hill.
Bass was 8p lower at 819-1/2p amid a general market sell-off and paring losses after the news. William Hill owner Brent Walker Group Plc was resilient, trading unchanged at 1-1/2p.
